messages:
maria (docs): FYI I opened PR #4123 — changelog + release notes for the model catalog update. It includes deprecation notes for tiny-redwood-1 and a short migration snippet. Need 1-2 reviewers for approval and a preferred merge window.
jonathan (product): Thanks — can you add a quick migration note about embedding dimensionality change? We should call it out bold in the notes.
eli (eng): I skimmed. The SDK example references `EmbeddingClient` v1 usage; we'll need to show the v2 compatibility snippet. I'll paste a patch in a sec.
sam (devex): Also saw one broken link in the API reference section — `%/models/tiny-redwood-1` -> should be `/models/tiny-redwood-1?variant=legacy`. I'll push a tiny fix.
ci-bot: CI: docs linter running on PR #4123 — running spellcheck, linkcheck, preview build.
ci-bot: linkcheck: 1 broken link found (/docs/models/tiny-redwood-1 -> 404).
eli (eng): here's the compatibility snippet I mentioned, add under "Migration":
```bash
# update model reference in client config
redwood models set-version tiny-redwood-1 tiny-redwood-2
# if using python SDK
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(model="tiny-redwood-2")
```

sam (devex): pushed link fix in 4123.2 (changed URL and added redirect note).
docs-preview-bot: Preview available: https://deploy-preview-4123--docs.redwood.dev (build #1125).
docs-preview-bot: build status: FAILED — 1 broken link (same as earlier) at /changelog/model-catalog.md line 54.
maria (docs): I can take the broken link — likely the migration anchor changed after last refactor. Will update the heading anchor and add a sentence about dimensionality gap.
jonathan (product): Good. Can we aim to merge after the docs deploy window at 4pm PT? We want release notes to go live with the model rollout (canary at 18:00 UTC).
eli (eng): 4pm PT SGTM. Also please add a short note that tiny-redwood-1 will be removed from hosted catalog on 2026-04-15. People need to pin versions if they need to keep it.
maria (docs): Added removal date and pinned-version recommendation. Updated migration snippet with note about embeddings shape.
ci-bot: New commit detected on branch docs/pr-4123: running checks again.
docs-preview-bot: Preview available: https://deploy-preview-4123--docs.redwood.dev (build #1126) — build status: SUCCESS.
jonathan (product): :eyes: Reviewing now, focusing on wording for deprecation impact.
sam (devex): Quick comment: the SDK example still shows `client.generate()` returning text — we should show `response.choices[0].text` for clarity.
eli (eng): addressed that in a follow-up commit.
maria (docs): Ready for approvals. @jonathan @eli can you both approve when you have a sec? I want to merge in the 4pm PT -> 5pm PT window.
jonathan (product): Approved. :shipit:
eli (eng): Approved.
maria (docs): Merging at 16:05 PT unless anyone raises blocking issues. Will also add a note to the changelog entry referencing the migration guide.
sam (devex): will watch for any fallout on SDK examples, can quick-patch if someone reports a mismatch.
ci-bot: PR #4123 merged by maria (docs) at 1775001405.
docs-preview-bot: Production docs updated: https://docs.redwood.dev/changelog/model-catalog — change set deployed.
maria (docs): Thanks team. I'll follow up with a short customer-facing blurb summarizing deprecation and recommended migration paths. :thumbsup:
